title_sq: Super Dupleks 3+1+2+pishine ne shitje tek Residenza Kodra e Diellit (ID 4151148).
description_sq:
Te Residenza Kodra e Diellit, shitet dupleks me qera, ndertim i ri, mobilim modern, hipoteke. Vila ka siperfaqe prej 200 m², organizohet ne sallon te bollshem, kuzhine me ambjent gatimi me vehte, 3 dhoma gjumi, korridor shperndares, depo per lavanderi, 3 tualete, ballkon, sistem chiller me kondicioner ne cdo dhome, bodrum. Apartamenti eshte i shtruar i gjithi me parket cilesor, ndricim dhe spote LED, tavane te varur. Dhomat kane orientim me diell dhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites, oborr me gjelberim, pishine. Vila eshte arreduar me arkitekt dhe mobiljet dhe elektroshtepiaket jane mjaft cilesore dhe fjala me e fundit e teknologjise. Punimet e viles jane te reja dhe te nje cilesie te larte. Kompleksi eshte i ri ndertuar vitet e fundit, prestigjoz dhe mjaft i preferuar per banim. Vila ndodhet ne nje zone te qete larg zhurmave dhe smogut te qytetit.
Cmimi 620000 euro.
title_en: Super Duplex 3+1+2+pool for sale at Residenza Kodra e Diellit (ID 4151148).
description_en: At Residenza Kodra e Diellit, duplex for rent, new construction, modern furniture, mortgage. The apartment is all laid with quality parquet, LED lighting and spots, suspended ceilings. The rooms have sunny orientation and natural lighting throughout the day, yard with greenery, swimming pool. The villa is furnished by an architect and the furniture and appliances are of high quality and the latest technology. The works of the villa are new and of a high quality. The complex is newly built in recent years, prestigious and quite preferred for housing. The villa is located in a quiet area away from the noise and smog of the city. The price is 620,000 euros.
